notes.title: Update v. 1.26
notes.content:
New Characters!

Now, on the character selection screen, three new characters are available. Upon choosing one of them, it will be necessary to complete a challenge to unlock their full use in the game. The challenges have a considered level of difficulty. It is not necessary to purchase additional items in the store to complete them.

Cosplay: A version of Bikini Girl wearing a heroine costume. Cosplay is a performative art in which practitioners wear costumes to portray a character from pop culture.
Challenge: Platforming

Succubus: A version of Chinese Girl. Succubus is a mythological being. A type of creature with a feminine appearance that invades men's dreams in order to steal their life energy.
Challenge: Platforming

Transhumanist: A version of the Actor. Transhumanists are individuals who use technology to evolve human condition to its maximum potentialities, reaching the level of post-human.
Challenge: Boss Fight
